_about: Hand-marked reference annotations, used while the YOLO26l weights are still being trained.
These are NOT model predictions. Every box here was marked by the project team by eye on the
real photograph named in `image`, and the app labels them 'hand annotation' everywhere they
appear (section 03, the 3D twin, the PDF report and the dashboard). They exist so the rest of
the pipeline - 3D placement, Gemini explanation, reporting - can be demonstrated end to end
before the detector exists. Delete this file (and re-run scripts/seed_annotations.py --clear)
once real detection runs are available.
Boxes are normalised to the image: x1, y1, x2, y2 in 0..1, origin top-left.
